question: Which unresolved mechanisms explain disproportionate Stellantis exposure to normalization, and what changes the recovery assessment?

method.access: Existing audits first; six discovery queries and one narrowly justified coupon follow-up. Selective HTML/PDF text reads. No agents, paid data, OCR, bulk scraping or fitting.
method.extraction: Model- and period-specific program passages, reported shopping outcomes, two pricing rows and quarterly OEM figures.
method.transformations: Difference arithmetic and channel identity, not causal regression.
method.alternatives: A full national trim-payment/stock panel would be more representative but not accessible in this bounded pass. Anecdotes identify possible mechanisms, not frequencies.
method.checks: Compass quarterly sums reconcile to annual totals; pricing arithmetic checked separately from source authenticity; source independence and population differences explicit.

gc_q4.fleet_identity: Delta fleet = -6514 - Delta retail. Positive retail growth requires fleet contraction greater than 6514 vehicles, assuming comparable populations and classification.
gc_q4.limit: No absolute retail base, 4xe channel split, or inference of consumer substitution.

hypothesis_updates.wholesale_pricing: Effective wholesale cost relative to rivals remains unmeasured. Sticker bridge strengthens timing mismatch; not invoice proof.
hypothesis_updates.dealer_programs: Finite allocation of support has independent other-model example; inventory-conditioning details remain testimonial.
hypothesis_updates.gc_channel: Strong new derived qualification: Q4 whole-model net total decline was in fleet while retail rose, conditional on comparable definitions. Not transferable to 4xe.
hypothesis_updates.gc_customer_offer: Dealer dispersion case strengthens distribution/negotiation mechanism; no national matched payment trend.
hypothesis_updates.ram_supply: Configuration friction can end in a completed sale; do not equate order cutoff with lost demand.
hypothesis_updates.compass: Growing annual total is not a clean price-cut response: H1 negative; Q3 supplies92.5% of net annual gain; household/fleet mix unresolved.

not_resolved: Effective dealer cost and actual payments versus rivals
Model-level dealer GPU and aged sellable stock

Annual-report SEC HTML fetch too large; no bulk retrieval to reprove baseline.
Dealer price memo screenshot cache miss; no visual verification claimed.
Canadian fleet programs, July2025 residual guide, current dealer pages and suspicious undated deal content excluded from2024US comparisons.
Complaint quotations of public Asbury call not treated as independent corroboration.
Fiat coupon program not assigned to Jeep/Ram without evidence.

exclude: Anonymous internal claims as verified numbers
National elasticity inferred from one deal
Historical MSRP bridge as net acquisition cost
Annual Compass growth as proven household recovery

stop_reason: Further causal precision requires program bulletins, model-channel data or deal-level cost/offer records; further broad narrative searches would recycle evidence.
